newsitem.title: FINLAND: HELSINKI AREA RENTS UP 8.3 PERCENT YR/YR IN APRIL.
newsitem.headline: HELSINKI AREA RENTS UP 8.3 PERCENT YR/YR IN APRIL.

text.p: Rents in the Helsinki area rose 8.3 percent year-on-year in April and rents in the rest of the country were 6.2 percent higher than a year earlier, Statistics Finland said in a statement on Monday.
The average rent for freely financed houses in the whole country was 42.70 markka per square metre, but the level in the Helsinki area was about 30 percent higher, SF said.
"People with new leases for one bedroom flats in central Helsinki paid an average of 76.90 markka a month per square metre," it said.
